title: Ephemeral Staging Template & Automated Lifecycle Engine

functional.scope: Source implementation of release manifest contract, ephemeral staging provision/verify/destroy controller, sanitized data preparation, inert-by-default orphan cleanup workflow, instance/compose/Caddy templates, runbook, and local contract/controller test suite.

hosted.note: Local/mocked tests prove controller behavior only and do not count as hosted drill evidence. Hosted acceptance requires two consecutive zero-to-zero staging releases after external prerequisites are provisioned.

external_wait_prerequisites: GCP CLI reauthentication (`gcloud auth login` / Workload Identity Federation setup) and confirmation of active non-production staging GCP project, billing, and Compute Engine quota.

Creation of GitHub `staging` Environment in `ajoe734/pantheon` (concurrency 1) and explicit configuration of `STAGING_GCP_PROJECT_ID`, `STAGING_GCP_ZONE`, `STAGING_INSTANCE_TEMPLATE`, `STAGING_SERVICE_ACCOUNT`, `STAGING_SANITIZED_SNAPSHOT`, `STAGING_EPHEMERAL_ENABLED=true`, and `STAGING_ORPHAN_CLEANUP_ENABLED=true`.
Genuine `dev_verified` release manifest after `DEV-SIX-AREA-HOSTED-CLOSEOUT-20261002` / all12 chain `h12-01a11-20261023-9aeb` is resolved.

Execution of two consecutive ephemeral staging releases starting from zero staging resources, passing all verification gates, and destroying all owned VM/disks/IP/IAM bindings with zero orphan inventory.
